snippet.title: Etrange Overlord - Gameplay Trailer (Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, and Steam)
snippet.description:
Even hell can't stop her! Étrange von Rosenburg is executed for a crime she did not commit and mistakenly sent to hell. Instead of despairing, she endeavors to live her best life, fire and brimstone be damned!

In this new action RPG, you'll have to make use of over a dozen unique characters, as well as the revolving lane, to master the chaos. Additionally, there's a unique multiplayer mode for up to four players locally and online! 

Upgrade your weapons, eat food to boost your chances, and find victory in the lowest of places when Etrange Overlord launches for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and PC on March 26, 2026.

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://nisamerica.com/etrange-overlord/
